data_objects.name: us_commute_tracts
data_objects.meaning: GeoPackage layer of US census tracts with commute-mode counts and percentages.
data_objects.notes: Layer Means_of_Transportation_to_Work uses multipolygon geometry with EPSG:4326.

data_objects.name: ncr_ride_bookings
data_objects.meaning: Ride-booking records for NCR locations with booking status, vehicle and route, arrival measures, cancellation/incomplete fields, value, distance, ratings, and payment method.

data_objects.name: nyc_taxi_zones
data_objects.meaning: ZIP archive containing one ESRI Shapefile of NYC taxi-zone polygons and lookup attributes.
data_objects.notes: The archive contains .shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj, and .cpg components under taxi_zones/; declared CRS is EPSG:2263.

data_objects.name: nyc_yellow_taxi_trips
data_objects.meaning: Monthly Parquet partitions of NYC yellow-taxi trip records for January through September 2024.
data_objects.notes: All nine partitions share the same 19-column Arrow schema.

variables.name: COUNTYFP
variables.meaning: Three-character county FIPS code within state.

variables.name: NAMELSAD
variables.meaning: Legal/statistical area description such as Census Tract 9450.01.

variables.name: NAME
variables.meaning: Long tract name including county and state.

variables.name: TOTAL
variables.meaning: Total workers represented by commute-mode estimates.

variables.name: CT
variables.meaning: Workers commuting by car, truck, or van, including alone and carpool.

variables.name: CA
variables.meaning: Workers driving alone by car, truck, or van.

variables.name: CC
variables.meaning: Workers carpooling by car, truck, or van.

variables.name: Booking ID
variables.meaning: Booking identifier; source values can retain embedded quote characters.

variables.name: Booking Status
variables.meaning: Booking outcome/status such as completed, incomplete, cancelled, or no driver found.

variables.name: Customer ID
variables.meaning: Customer identifier; source values can retain embedded quote characters.

variables.name: Avg VTAT
variables.meaning: Average vehicle time-to-arrival measure as stored.

variables.name: Avg CTAT
variables.meaning: Average customer time-to-arrival measure as stored.

variables.name: Reason for cancelling by Customer
variables.meaning: Reason for customer cancellation; otherwise missing.

variables.name: Driver Cancellation Reason
variables.meaning: Reason for driver cancellation; otherwise missing.

variables.name: Incomplete Rides Reason
variables.meaning: Reason for an incomplete ride; otherwise missing.

variables.name: Booking Value
variables.meaning: Monetary booking value; unavailable for some statuses.

variables.name: Ride Distance
variables.meaning: Ride distance as supplied; unavailable for some statuses.

variables.name: Driver Ratings
variables.meaning: Driver rating; populated only where applicable.

variables.name: Customer Rating
variables.meaning: Customer rating; populated only where applicable.

variables.name: Payment Method
variables.meaning: Payment-method category; may be missing for unsuccessful bookings.

variables.name: LocationID
variables.meaning: Taxi-zone location identifier; joins to trip pickup/drop-off IDs.

variables.name: passenger_count
variables.meaning: Driver-entered passenger count; may be missing.

variables.name: store_and_fwd_flag
variables.meaning: Y/N flag indicating temporary in-vehicle storage before transmission.

variables.name: tip_amount
variables.meaning: Recorded tip amount; cash tips may not be captured.

structure.description: The nine yellow-taxi Parquet files are monthly partitions with an identical schema; filename month supplies the intended partition label.
Yellow-taxi PULocationID and DOLocationID join to taxi_zones.LocationID for pickup and drop-off geography.
In the commute layer, CT is the car/truck/van total and is composed of CA plus CC; percentage fields correspond to their count fields relative to TOTAL.
The commute layer, NCR bookings, and NYC taxi collections describe separate geographies and populations with no declared row-level key between them.

uncertainties: The NCR table does not declare units for arrival-time measures, booking value, or ride distance.
Taxi categorical code mappings are not embedded in the Parquet schema and should not be guessed from numeric values.
Filename-based month partitions can still contain timestamp anomalies near or outside nominal month boundaries.
The stored Shape_Leng and Shape_Area attribute units are not declared and need not match geometry CRS units.
annotation_notes: All source attributes are listed separately; the Shapefile geometry is also named explicitly.
